lines: The episode argues that the AI agent era will render traditional operating systems like macOS and Windows obsolete by enabling malleable, agent-first computing environments.
DHH notes that historical barriers to Linux adoption have become major advantages, as agents thrive on command-line control and granular configuration files.
The podcast highlights that massive codebases are no longer competitive moats because AI allows individuals to replicate complex software in weeks.
Speakers suggest that this shift presents the first viable opportunity in 25 years to challenge the operating system duopoly with Linux.
The discussion emphasizes that while AI handles code execution, human taste remains the critical differentiator in producing high-quality software.
title: Why the Agent Era Needs a New Operating System | DHH
